financials.scope: ANIIMS MD/MS; state and AIQ admissions
financials.title: ANIIMS MD/MS annual charges, stipend and service bond
financials.notes: Annual academic fee 33,000 + learning resource fee 44,000 + establishment charges 33,000. First admission additionally 50,000 admission fee and 25,000 refundable college deposit. Hostel 4,000/month deducted from stipend, plus refundable 10,000 deposit. Service-default penalty additionally recovers stipend drawn, per page 6.
financials.instituteName: Andaman and Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS)

financials.scope: ANIIMS post-MBBS DNB in-service seats
financials.title: ANIIMS DNB fees and stipend
financials.notes: DNB in-service candidates must serve A&N Administration for at least 10 years after completion (page 4). Additional 20,000/month is payable during postings at Apollo Hospital Chennai. MD/MS 1-year bond must not be substituted for this service condition; DNB default amount unreported here.
financials.instituteName: Andaman and Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS)

financials.scope: SVIMS MD/MS except separately specified MS Orthopaedics/BIRRD
financials.title: SVIMS MD/MS fees, stipend and service bond
financials.notes: Tuition 175,000/year; annual library fee 5,000 additional. University fee 25,600 and other admission charges separate. Discontinuation additionally repays stipend. In-service candidates drawing leave salary do not receive stipend. Figures for MS Orthopaedics are separately specified.
financials.instituteName: Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences (SVIMS), Tirupati

financials.scope: MS Orthopaedics at BIRRD academically attached to SVIMS

financials.notes: Tuition 30,000/year and one-time University fee 25,600. Prospectus states all other training regulations same as other PGs; SVIMS service/discontinuation conditions apply, including stipend recovery on discontinuation.
financials.instituteName: SVIMS / BIRRD Hospital, Tirupati
